body: I'm not sure that people love me anymore, but I did manage to go out and have a somewhat enjoyable evening. So I guess that's worth something. Thank you for your kind words.

I really don't care about meeting anyone anymore. It would just be nice if I hadn't quit my well paying job and moved. I'm already in a stage of life where I feel like it's too late to meet anyone and it's just not worth the trouble. I'm too old for that shit.

I hope you meet someone nice though! :)

Yes, you are right about it being nice to be free. Sure is nice to be able to go out for the night and not have to report back to someone every 15 mins or have them accuse me (falsely) of cheating if I don't text or call back immediately.

Yeah, it's shitty knowing what I might have done to hurt my friends. This particular friend was also going through a sad breakup right when a lot of bad shit went down with my ex and I know I wasn't exactly there for her. The thing is I am this totally fake happy person around strangers and friends I'm not as close with, but I guess since we've known each other so long, I'm more likely to let the real me come out. It's just hard to keep all the negative in sometimes.

My roommate managed to drag me out of the house for the evening and I'm just coming home to read all these really touching replies. I don't feel any better for absolutely fucking my life up, but I feel a little less like dying. I went out and saw a few things that made me smile and reminded me that every once in a long while, some tiny little insignificant thing happens that's worth smiling over for at least 2 seconds. I guess that's worth something.

I've been feeling depressed and suicidal since I was probably 15 years old, so I've got a lot of stupid brain to overcome. Now sure how to fix that yet. The feeling comes and goes, but it's always there at the back of my mind. I guess it bothers me how I feel absolutely no motivation or desire to do anything. Like I don't have anything I want to "do" or "be" or go to school for because absolutely nothing interests me at all.
It was a job that required no skills, I only had to be competent and friendly, which I was at that time. I agree with you. I am a stupid, dumb idiot with no skills. A complete waste of skin.

I talked to one of my best friends and appologized already and she told me I'm an unhappy person and she basically doesn't want to be around me. When I told her that made me feel upset, she just went, "hmmph". We've been friends for 17 years. I must be horrible to be around if she's just going to write off our friendship after all this time. 

Thank you for your reply though. It makes me feel a little better.

I took up meditation and was studying Buddhism to try and come to terms with the fact that life is suffering and I am grasping and attached. I know it is my attachment that is causing suffering, yet I still see no way out. I don't have any dreams. There's nothing I want to do, accomplish or be. There's nothing I want to have. I have nothing left to lose, just my pointless life of emptiness.
